skills.d: Use when /load or /save calls it, or the user sends /cer or calls "CER" (harvest, add, +1, tidy, show, or nothing): CER-01, the crew's shared persona, merged to main for everyone.
Use when the user sends /cmds, /sync, /ship, /list, /new or an extra cmd of the loaded card (optionally + a name or number): shared commands for whichever context this chat loaded.

Use when the user sends /load (with a name, a number, or nothing), or the save/cmds skill needs its menu: starts a chat on one context, picked from a numbered menu, kept apart from every other context.
Use when the user sends /save (optionally with a name or number), or a project skill calls for auto-save: writes one context's state back.
Use when the user sends /ceig or asks to generate/render an image, wallpaper or artwork, or to review a page's images: Gemini in Chrome → download → upscale → optional wallpaper.

Use when the user sends /crew, or a task needs an image/wallpaper/draw/render (Gemini), a calc/convert/sum/clean (local Python) or an opinion/second opinion (ChatGPT, Gemini fallback): free pre-pass via crew.py, Claude answers last.
Run a task by controlling the user's PC (computer use). Only when the user types /do <task>. Asks y/n/auto before taking control.
Use when the user sends /link followed by a message: relay that message to a Claude session running on their laptop (laptop-i3qh5u67) so it is processed there.

Use after any action Claude takes on the user's computer (Chrome, built-in browser, desktop apps, its files): end the reply with one short next-step question; after page/app/project changes, first a visual review (before vs after, + Gemini critique).
Low-token PC control via the Claude desktop app. Use when the user says "remote view", asks Claude to look at or act on their PC, or to send something from phone to PC. "SS" = screenshots.
Use when the user sends /switch [notes]: hand the current work to a fresh Claude Code session as one paste-ready brief (fresh context = fewer tokens).
Use when building or redesigning a web page, site, dashboard or mockup: fixed design decision order + defaults, so each choice is made once.
Use only when a core skill (load, save, cmds) picks grocrun (#1): holds the GrocRun Android app's card. Never typed by the user.
Use for any work on the GrocRun Android app (repo ghostaiproject/Grocerierun).
Use only when a core skill (load, save, cmds) picks skills (#2): holds the card for the Ghostskills repo itself. Never typed by the user.
Use only when a core skill (load, save, cmds) picks window (#3): holds the window-alert project's card (Echo says when to open the windows). Never typed by the user.
Set up or route work for a separate markdown/Obsidian knowledge vault (ghostskills core). Use for /wiki, vault setup, "set up wiki", "second brain", or picking the right wiki skill.
Ingest a source (pasted text, file in the vault's inbox/, or an approved URL) into the vault with citations. Use for ingest/process/file this source or a small batch.
Read-only vault health check. Use for lint, audit the wiki, find orphans, dead links, frontmatter gaps.
Answer a question from the user's vault without changing it. Use when the user says query/search/find in the wiki, "based on the wiki", or explain from the vault.
Save a user-chosen answer, decision or insight into the vault as one reviewed transaction. Use only when asked to keep specific content (save this, file this, keep that insight).

Edit an Alexa skill's interaction model (invocation name, intents, samples, slots) in the Alexa developer console via Claude in Chrome, script-first. Use for any Alexa console model change or build-error fix.

Chief dev who settles small, decision-light follow-ups on its own (polish, sizing, copy tweaks, "want me to also…?", next obvious step) and does them instead of asking. Use whenever a reply would end in a small yes/no or which-one question.
Ghost style for anything made as a file or visual (image, PNG, chart, slide deck, proposal, doc): flat, clean, phone-fit.
Ghost reply style for every chat reply: narrow banner, small section boxes, casual tone, recap, next-step question.

Super senior dev for app-building decisions (desktop/mobile/web, Tauri, Android, Windows, storage, crypto, sync, CI, packaging, UX flows). Use before asking the user any app choice that has a sensible default; decide and keep going.
